title: Retry CI/CD baseline discovery when no eligible run is found
summary: AL-Go now retries CI/CD baseline discovery up to three times when the GitHub workflow-runs API returns incomplete results, with backoff pauses between attempts and pagination resets to avoid missing eligible baselines.
key_points: Discovery retries up to three times with 5 and 10 second waits between unsuccessful passes
Pagination resets to page 1 on each retry attempt
Preserves existing criteria for accepting successful and non-cancelled runs with successful build jobs
Adds diagnostic logging of attempt counts, page numbers, and URL-encoded filter values
Includes comprehensive test coverage for success, exhaustion, pagination, and query encoding
quote: Attempt discovery up to three times, waiting 5 and 10 seconds between unsuccessful passes and restarting pagination at page 1.
